title: TIL that  Muji once sold a car . “The Muji Car 1000...
content: TIL that Muji once sold a car. “The Muji Car 1000 was a debadged and stripped down 2-door version of the Nissan March, with the smallest engine, an automatic, steel wheels, and A/C, available in one color: white.”
author: Jason Kottke
